description: A green cloth-covered surface holds piles of colorful seed beads, a partly made purple-and-white beaded strand, a tape dispenser, and a red string off to the left. The left hand lifts the thin thread up and away from the beaded strand, then lowers back toward the bead piles and sweeps across them as if sorting and picking up beads, while the right hand stays near the bead area and briefly hovers without taking hold; no two-hand object is used.
